name: DS Cluster D08: Calendar Release ID Sweep
description: Tests all documented FRED release IDs + Treasury + release_id=0 to find which have data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D08: Calendar Release ID Sweep
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === Every documented FRED release_id ===
cal_0 = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=0)()
cal_10 = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=10)()
cal_21 = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=21)()
cal_46 = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=46)()
cal_50 = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)()
cal_53 = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=53)()

# === Treasury mode ===
cal_note = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.Treasury, security_type=TreasurySecurityType.Note, term=TreasuryTerm.Y10)()
cal_bond = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.Treasury, security_type=TreasurySecurityType.Bond)()
cal_bill = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.Treasury, security_type=TreasurySecurityType.Bill)()

# === Reporters (just need data to exist) ===
histogram(category="Calendar", title="Close", bins=20)(close)
